provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2026 Stanley Cup Final as played (the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Vegas Golden Knights in six): the field is every skater who dressed in the Final, named and placed by birth country from the NHL's rosters and player pages; ranking is the skater's 2025-26 regular-season Power Play total with the club (2 per goal + assists + shots on goal). Each game's box score (goals, assists, shots on goal) is from the NHL's gamecenter boxscores, cross-checked skater by skater against ESPN's box scores, which agree on every line. A skater with no goal, assist or shot in a game has an empty line.
